questions.explanationEn: UPPCS (झृ) Ghhgah History, 2002 Explanation- In 731 AD, the Arabs established the first city on the banks of river Indus at Mahpuja and after that the second city was established at Mansoora. Muhammad bin Qasim attacked Sindh in 712 AD. After reaching Makran, he got the help of the king there and joined the Jats and Medes dissatisfied with Dahir's rule on his side. The rebellious Buddhists also helped him. First of all, Muhammad bin Qasim attacked Dewal and took it under his control and killed all the men above 17 years of age. Dahir himself got frightened by his attack and did not send any army to face him in Dewal. In this way, without any resistance, Muhammad got the southern part of Sindh. After this, he crossed the Indus river after conquering Neerun, Sehwan and Sisam.

questions.questionTextEn: Whose court did the great poet Firdaisi grace?
questions.questionTextHi: महन कावि फिरदैसी किसके द्रबार की शोभा बढ़ता था?
questions.explanationEn: TGT History, 2004 (canceled) Explanation – The poet Firdaisi of the East, known as Hemar, graced the court of Sultan Mahmud Ghaznavi. His important work is Shahnama.
questions.explanationHi: TGT History्, 2004 (निरस्त) व्याख्या – पूर्व का हेमर कह्लाने वाला कावि फिरदैसी सुल्तान मह्मूद गजनवी के द्रबार की शोभा बढ़ता था। इनकी मह्त्वपूर्ण रचना शाह्नामा' है। एेसा कह जाता है कि शाह्नामा लिखने ह्ेतु सुल्तान ने उसे साठ ह्जार सोने का सिक्यका द्ेने का प्रण किया था। अंतत: अपनी बात से मुकर कर उसके स्थन पर साठ ह्जार चांदी का मिशकल दिया। परिणामत: फिरदैसी ›ुद्ध होकर गजनी को सद के लिए त्याग दिया।
